title: GIVING TUESDAY - Chamber Gives Back - Convoy of Hope
seo_title: Giving Tuesday Volunteering at Convoy of Hope, Springfield
description: This is a Giving Tuesday volunteer event at Convoy of Hope's World Distribution Center, sponsored by the Republic Area Chamber of Commerce. Volunteers count, sort, and box or bag product and help clean up their work area at the end; closed-toe shoes, comfortable clothing, and a current liability waiver are required, and youth ages 10-12 need a parent or guardian and a signed consent form. It runs Tuesday, December 1, 2026, from 6:30 to 8:30 PM at One Convoy Drive in Springfield, MO, with volunteers typically arriving around 6 to 6:15 PM.
venue: Convoy of Hope World Distribution Center
